Perfect for sautéing, frying, roasting, and baking, Al-Ghazal Vegetable Ghee adds depth and richness to rice, legumes, pastries, breads, and traditional favorites. Its dependable performance and delicious flavor make it a kitchen staple for everyday cooking and special recipes alike. Trusted for quality and consistency, Al-Ghazal Vegetable Ghee brings rich taste and cooking flexibility to your pantry.

products.name: Ziyad Za'atar

products.name: Ziyad BBQ Mashewe Spice Blend

products.name: Ziyad Shish Taouk Spice Blend

products.name: Ziyad Ouze Spice Blend
products.description: Ziyad Ouze Spice Blend brings together flavors of allspice, cardamom, black pepper, nutmeg, ginger, clove, and cinnamon to create a delicious and aromatic blend that elevates your favorite dishes. products.name: Ziyad Turkish Baharat spice blend
products.description: Ziyad Turkish Baharat Spice Blend brings together flavors of coriander, clove, saffron, cardamom, cumin, paprika, and nutmeg to create a delicious and aromatic blend that elevates your favorite dishes. products.name: Ziyad Lahme Bel Ajeen Spice Blend
products.description: Ziyad Lahme Bel Ajeen Spice Blend combines the delicious and authentic Middle Eastern flavors of cumin, turmeric, cardamom, ground fennel, cinnamon, bay leaves, and black pepper. This spice is essential when making the iconic Middle Eastern meat flatbread, Lahme Bi Ajeen.

products.name: Ziyad Gulf Biryani Spice Blend
products.description: Ziyad Gulf Biryani Spice Blend combines the delicious and authentic Middle Eastern flavors of turmeric, cumin, ground clove, ground fennel, cardamom, and cinnamon. Use it to elevate chicken and vegetable biryani, or try it in curries!

products.name: Ziyad Chicken Shawarma Spice Blend
products.description: Ziyad Chicken Shawarma Spice Blend takes chicken to the next level by giving it a bold and rich flavor. Transform your chicken into delicious shawarma that is perfect for salads, sandwiches, and wraps. Can also be used with any other meat!

products.name: Ziyad Makloubeh Spice Blend
products.description: Makloubeh spice blend is primarily made with cinnamon and allspice and adds delicious flavor to rice, meat, and vegetable dishes. Ziyad Makloubeh Spice Blend is a must-have when making the iconic Palestinian one-pot “upside down” dish of Makloubeh.

products.name: Ziyad Cardamom Powder
products.description: Cardamom powder's blend of peppery, piney, earthy, and aromatic flavors makes it an incredibly versatile spice that takes any recipe to the next level. Try cardamom with curry dishes, lentils, poultry, red meats, and even chai!

products.description: Ground paprika has a toasty red color and adds brightness, richness, and a spicy kick to any ingredient it is paired with. products.name: Ziyad Seven Spice Blend
products.description: Ziyad's Seven Spice Blend combines cardamom, black pepper, cinnamon, allspice, nutmeg, clove, and ginger to create a versatile, flavorful, and delicious kitchen staple that can be used on a wide range of ingredients and dishes. products.name: Ziyad AllSpice Ground
